title: Formulary Benefit Exception Priority for Member-Opened Requests: Days Left against Decision Time
content:
**Rule.** A member-opened exception request under the Formulary Benefit is expedited when the days of the drug the member has left are fewer than the days the member waits for a standard decision. It is standard otherwise.

**Definitions.**
- **Days left.** The days supply of the member's latest fill of the drug, less the days from that fill's ship date or date of service to the handling date. The latest fill is the latest shipped home delivery order of the drug, or the latest paid retail fill of it when that fill is more recent, meaning its date of service is later than the order's date. Where the member has neither, the days left are zero.
- **Days of a standard decision.** The formulary's standard decision hours divided by twenty-four.

## Comparison grid

| Days left compared with days of a standard decision | Priority |
|---|---|
| fewer | expedited |
| equal | standard |
| more | standard |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; formulary standard decision time of 72 hours, which is 3 days)

| Latest fill | Days since it | Days left | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| home delivery order, 30 days | 28 | 2 | expedited (2 is fewer than 3) |
| paid retail fill, 30 days, more recent than the last order | 27 | 3 | standard (3 is not fewer than 3) |
| home delivery order, 90 days | 40 | 50 | standard |
